style_summary: A prestige culture-magazine cover system built from one monumental grayscale portrait, narrow Didone display type, condensed editorial callouts, selective deep-crimson documentary fragments, and a visibly fibrous newsprint finish.

environment_variables.SUBJECT: fictional or non-identifiable editorial portrait subject
environment_variables.SUBJECT_ACTION: controlled pose, gaze, or small gesture
environment_variables.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: one restrained object connected to the profile story
environment_variables.BACKGROUND_ELEMENTS: secondary documentary fragments and contextual details
environment_variables.SECONDARY_TEXT: short supporting cover lines rendered verbatim
environment_variables.STYLE_FIDELITY_ANCHORS: observable style traits that must remain visible
environment_variables.SOURCE_CONTENT_TO_AVOID: literal source content that generated samples must not recreate

style_fidelity_anchors: Prestige editorial-cover hierarchy with an oversized top masthead, one dominant central portrait, and a dark typography-heavy lower zone.
A single close-cropped grayscale head-and-shoulders portrait occupies most of the frame and partially occludes the masthead.
The subject sits slightly off center, leaving narrow asymmetric side gutters for tightly stacked editorial copy.
The background remains a flat warm bone-white paper field with no scenic depth; secondary fragments enter only as layered print collage.
The palette stays strictly warm off-white, soot black, grayscale, and deep crimson, with crimson used as a selective signal rather than a broad fill.
Ultra-large narrow high-contrast Didone serif lettering is paired with bold uppercase condensed grotesk callouts and tiny neutral metadata.
Dense but controlled copy blocks use short manual line breaks, tight leading, and crisp left or right alignment around the portrait.
Large pale serif feature lettering crosses the near-black lower portrait or garment mass and may crop at the canvas edge.
Small four-point diamond sparks, thin rules, and occasional crimson caption bars punctuate the page sparingly.
The entire image carries fibrous uncoated paper, dry-ink speckle, subtle halftone, slightly distressed letter edges, and mild registration imperfection.
Soft directional monochrome portrait lighting creates luminous silvery midtones, crisp eyes, textured skin, glossy dark hair, and deep garment shadows.
The mood remains cinematic, intellectual, austere, and archival, like contemporary arts journalism printed with mid-century press character.
source_content_to_avoid: Any recognizable likeness, facial structure, hairstyle, gaze, pose, or silhouette of Cillian Murphy or another real public figure.
The original male-actor portrait concept, black formal jacket with decorative pins, or an identical three-quarter head position.
The original publication name, exact masthead lockup, star-shaped letterform, issue metadata, barcode, price, or publisher identity.
Every original English or Vietnamese headline, caption, date, award claim, personal name, and supporting cover line.
The best-actor, Oscar, game-of-the-year, AI-filmmaking, or Vietnamese war-cinema story premises.
Red-tinted duplicate images or film stills of the same person and the exact lower-background collage arrangement.
Any exact logo, signature, watermark, username, platform mark, QR code, brand mark, or identifiable publication device.
The precise source text coordinates or line breaks when they would reproduce the original cover instead of only its broader hierarchy.

visual_deconstruction.overall_style: Cinematic prestige-magazine cover combining monochrome portrait photography with archival print-modernist art direction.
visual_deconstruction.composition_and_layout: A giant masthead spans the top; a face dominates the center; short cover lines fill asymmetric side gutters; an oversized feature line lands over the dark lower third.
visual_deconstruction.subject_placement: Tight head-and-shoulders crop, slightly off center, with hair or head overlapping the masthead and the lower garment forming a dark base for pale typography.
visual_deconstruction.camera_and_perspective: Eye-level close portrait with a three-quarter turn, shallow environmental depth, compressed editorial framing, and direct psychological presence.
visual_deconstruction.typography: Narrow high-contrast Didone display serif for masthead and hero headline, condensed bold sans for topical callouts, and tiny neutral sans for folio-like metadata.
visual_deconstruction.color: Warm bone paper, soot black, neutral grays, and deep crimson; photographs are grayscale except for selective crimson duotone documentary fragments.
visual_deconstruction.graphic_elements: Sparse four-point sparks, thin rules, crimson caption bars, small folio lines, and torn or irregular collage transitions.
visual_deconstruction.texture_and_finish: Fibrous uncoated paper, dry ink, fine speckle, restrained halftone, slight registration drift, and gently distressed type edges.
visual_deconstruction.lighting: Soft directional monochrome light with luminous facial midtones, crisp eye detail, deep hair and wardrobe blacks, and minimal background modeling.
visual_deconstruction.mood: Severe, cerebral, cinematic, rebellious, and culturally prestigious without becoming glossy or luxurious.

composition.primary_hierarchy: Top masthead, monumental portrait, asymmetric side-copy modules, then a large lower feature line across the dark garment or collage mass.
composition.portrait_scale: The head and shoulders occupy roughly 55 to 70 percent of the frame; crop hair, shoulders, or feature lettering when needed to create editorial tension.
composition.copy_density: Keep both side gutters active with three to five short typographic modules, but preserve a clean halo around the eyes and central facial planes.
composition.ratio_adaptation: For 4:5, use a tall magazine-cover stack. For 5:4, widen the masthead and distribute copy laterally while retaining the same cover hierarchy and dominant portrait rather than opening into a landscape scene.
composition.depth: Treat the page as flat layered print: portrait cutout, paper field, text, and documentary fragments. Do not build a deep cinematic environment.

typography.masthead: Extremely large, narrow, high-contrast Didone capitals with sharp unbracketed serifs, close spacing, and selective black-to-crimson color changes.
typography.feature_headline: Oversized pale Didone capitals with tight leading, set over the darkest lower image mass and allowed to crop at an outer edge.
typography.callouts: Bold uppercase condensed grotesk sans, stacked in short blocks with selective crimson words or crimson label bars.
typography.metadata: Tiny neutral or condensed sans in black, with wide tracking only for brief folio-like lines.
typography.rendering: All supplied text should be rendered verbatim with editorially intentional line breaks, dry-ink edges, and no decorative fonts outside the defined pairing.

color_palette.proportion_rule: Approximately 52 percent bone paper and silver grayscale, 36 percent soot black, and no more than 12 percent deep crimson.

photographic_direction.subject: Use a fictional adult with clearly original, non-celebrity facial features and natural skin texture.
photographic_direction.lens_and_crop: Simulate an 85 mm editorial portrait at eye level, tightly cropped to head and shoulders with a slight three-quarter turn.
photographic_direction.light: One broad directional key light, gentle facial falloff, bright catchlights, deep black hair and wardrobe, and no colorful rim light.
photographic_direction.processing: Convert the main portrait to rich neutral grayscale with restrained contrast; reserve crimson duotone for small background fragments only.
photographic_direction.finish: Merge photography into the paper through halftone, dry ink, and light grain without obscuring the eyes or major text.

design_rules: Establish the masthead and portrait overlap first; all smaller copy must defer to that silhouette.
Keep one face dominant and limit props to a single quiet story clue near an edge or in the lower crop.
Use crimson only for selected masthead letters, one or two callouts, documentary fragments, and tiny accent marks.
Preserve flat editorial layering and irregular collage edges instead of adding scenic perspective or floating 3D decoration.
Maintain deliberate type contrast: Didone for prestige and scale, condensed grotesk for urgency, neutral sans for metadata.
Apply grain and distress consistently across paper, photography, and type while protecting readability and facial detail.
Adapt horizontal output as a widened cover composition, not as a banner, film still, or environmental portrait.
do: Use a close, psychologically present grayscale portrait with original non-celebrity features.
Let the portrait overlap the masthead and let pale feature type cross the darkest lower image area.
Keep short side-column headlines dense, legible, and rhythmically staggered around the face.
Use deep crimson as a measured editorial accent and in compact duotone documentary fragments.
Preserve visible bone-paper fibers, dry ink, fine speckle, and slight analog imperfection.
avoid: Do not create a recognizable real person, celebrity likeness, copied pose, or copied wardrobe details.
Do not reuse the original masthead, publication identity, wording, awards story, actor theme, or film-war collage.
Do not use full-color portrait photography, broad red gradients, neon hues, glossy commercial retouching, or chrome effects.
Do not introduce deep environments, cinematic scenery, multiple equal-size people, or an open landscape composition.
Do not use rounded playful fonts, generic geometric sans for the masthead, script lettering, or decorative display clutter.
Do not make the page spacious or minimalist; preserve controlled editorial density without covering the eyes.
Do not add watermarks, logos, signatures, usernames, platform marks, QR codes, barcodes, or publisher identifiers.
Do not over-degrade the image with heavy scratches, crushed facial detail, illegible text, or chaotic registration errors.
negative_prompt: Recognizable celebrity or public figure; copied face, hairstyle, pose, wardrobe pins, masthead, publication name, original English or Vietnamese copy, Oscar or best-actor framing, gaming awards, AI filmmaking, war-film premise, exact red film-still collage, logo, watermark, signature, username, platform mark, QR code, barcode, price, full-color skin, neon, broad gradients, glossy advertising retouch, chrome, 3D type, deep environment, wide cinematic scene, multiple equal subjects, smiling lifestyle photography, rounded playful typography, script font, sparse minimalist cover, blocked eyes, muddy face, unreadable text, excessive scratches, heavy glitch, random extra letters.
